summary: Tested the SOP Practice Lab (backend + UI) and the landing page's top-10 SOP section. All requested features work. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass. All 55 labs are ready, and 55 of the 67 SOP cards have has_lab. GET /api/sop-labs/{id} does not return answers, explanations, verdict, severity or evidence flags (each log only has ts/source/line). It returns 403 for the non-paying student, 404 for an unknown id and 401 when logged out. Submit returns 400 for a wrong answer count. A perfect submit scores 100 and gives +50 XP once (admin xp went 45 -> 95); the second pass gives 0 XP and xp stays the same. Picking every containment action lowers the score. Answer positions are shuffled across labs and grading uses the shuffled indices. UI: the landing grid shows exactly 10 cards, all Critical. 'View all 67 SOPs' links to /sops. /sops shows 55 sop-lab-chip elements. On the SOP detail page, logged-out users and the student see sop-lab-locked and no start button; admin sees sop-lab-start pointing to /app/sop-lab/{id}. The student opening the lab URL directly gets an 'Unlock the SOP library' message and a back link. Admin lab: alert, entities and context render; the log filter works and shows an empty state; Next stays disabled until an option is picked; Back keeps the selection; Submit stays disabled until verdict, severity and containment are chosen. Results show the score, per-question marks, explanations, verdict/severity marks and 6 highlighted evidence log lines. Retry resets the lab and clears the highlights. lab-best is shown after reload. There is no horizontal scroll on mobile.

minor.issue: Out-of-range answers (99 or -1) and invalid verdict/severity strings return 200 (graded as wrong) instead of 422/400. A -1 answer makes the frontend show 'Your answer: undefined'. Validate answers in 0..3 and restrict verdict/severity to Literal values.
If a ready lab exists but find_sop() returns None, s['title'] raises a 500. Add a None guard that returns 404.

Lab sop-m365-password-spray has 22 log lines; the spec says 14-20 and there is no validation for it. 4 labs (m365-password-spray, shellcode-injection, svchost-spawning-cmd, exec-unusual-directory) have log lines longer than 260 chars; the prompt limit is 220.

None of the 5 free static SOPs (phishing, bruteforce, malware, powershell, impossible-travel) has a lab, so the 'free SOPs are practisable' path never applies. Non-paying students cannot open any lab. This may be intended; please confirm.

integration_issues.issue: lab-best header is not updated after a submit; it only refreshes on reload. Minor.

issues: The final severity row uses grid-cols-4, so the 'Medium' and 'Critical' labels are cramped and clipped at the button edges. Use grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 or smaller padding.

action_items: Validate submit body: answers in 0..3, verdict in {true_positive,false_positive}, severity in SEVERITIES
Make the severity grid responsive on mobile
Optional: update lab-best after submit; enforce the 14-20 log count and the line length cap in build_lab validation
critical_code_review_comments: The shuffle is seeded per sop_id only, so every user gets the same order. Answer keys can be shared, which is acceptable for practice.

The submit response exposes the full answer key even when the attempt fails, so a user can submit zeros and then retry for 100%. XP is only +50 once per lab, so the impact is low, but consider rate-limiting or hiding answers until a pass or a few attempts.
can_practise does not check FREE_IDS for labs, because the free SOPs have no labs.
seed_data_creation: Admin account: about 12 sop_lab_attempts were added across 6 labs. Admin xp went 45 -> 95 from the +50 first pass on sop-m365-password-spray, which changes the seeded admin's XP. Admin now has a best score of 100 on that lab, so its first-pass XP can no longer be re-tested with admin. One attempt was also made on sop-shellcode-injection via mobile UI (not submitted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with `pytest tests/test_sop_lab.py -n 0`. Admin has already passed sop-m365-password-spray, so test_perfect_score_100 now only checks that no XP is given on later passes. To test first-pass XP, use another lab with admin. The student gets 403 on all labs. Login testids: login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button.
